# METRICS_INGEST

Where metrics are written and queried, and the monitoring CRDs a consumer may use.

<!-- Generated by nix/signature-docs.nix from nix build .#referencePages -->

Canonically `metrics`. A floe providing this must declare it
as `provides.metrics`; a hole that resolves it may be called
anything.
